data.representation: same SharedPacketSelector, physical residual features and clean-teacher KL preference loss; LoRa 8x1024 and WiSig 8x32 with independently sourced experts, teacher and selector weights

data.exposure: same source V RX panels and historical comparisons repeatedly exposed by prior development; no target input or truth

permissions.claim_scope: Explicitly user-authorized classifier-guided source-U training. Frozen LoRa W24 E104 and WiSig Tri-SIG-TIME SSL F0 default heads supply soft distributions and binary expert-preference pseudo-labels; no U TX, V, target IQ/truth/statistics, classifier update or cross-dataset checkpoint transfer. Deploy selector uses current IQ and experts; classifier is not used in routing.

checkpoint.initialization: Identical independently initialized zero-logit SharedPacketSelector per dataset; tie selects R17. Expert and classifier weights separately source-matched and frozen.

sources.role: WiSig original full R17 and action
LoRa E104 real-gain screen comparison only
WiSig frozen DURA v1 same-packet screen predictions
frozen same-ID LoRa-trained R69 architecture adaptation; distinct from original WiSig DURA v1 weights

checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed source final step 1000. LoRa hard-scene net >=1 in each fixed half and clean >=-1 versus every available same-packet control including LoRa R69 adaptation. WiSig each half net >=2 and clean >=-2 against each control including fixed DURA v1. Original fixed WiSig DURA v1 checkpoint has no lawful matched LoRa transfer; disclose as unavailable.

execution.gpu_policy: Two distinct GPUs from [0,5,3,6,1,4], each >=8192 MiB free; preserve all other owners and verify post-launch.
execution.stop_rule: Stop affected run on provenance/data-contract mismatch, occupied immutable output, no source-only checkpoint smoke, nonfinite loss/gradient, prediction matrix mismatch, query or truth-boundary violation; preserve partial artifacts and all other processes.

notes: User authorized this exact two-dataset source teacher guidance on 2026-11-28; protocol amendment and proposal specify scope. Same SharedPacketSelector, physical features, KL preference pseudo-label and inference rule; separate source-matched teacher, experts and weights.

For source U clean x and its simulated received y, freeze each data-specific teacher F. Compare KL(softmax(F(x)) || softmax(F(expert(y)))) and use the lower-KL expert as a binary pseudo-label. Train disturbed gate BCE + 0.5 clean gate BCE; teacher and experts fixed, no U true TX.

LoRa frozen W24 E104 teacher and historical real-gain parent inherit prior supervised/PL knowledge. WiSig frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL F0 default head inherits its original labeled/SSL knowledge; WiSig real-gain expert is F-free. This new gate is classifier-guided, not F-free.

AdamW 0.0003 cosine to 0.00003, 1000 final updates. Training teacher examples 24000 LoRa and 144000 WiSig from six forwards per source-U exposure, plus parent costs; no source V or target input/truth/statistics used in training.

Same 60 LoRa b200_1 and 360 WiSig RX1 low-urban and clean source V packets as earlier, repeatedly exposed. Fixed per-half improvement and clean limits apply against all matched controls; passing requires further predeclared replication before formal target testing.
